description: Validate a Mexican CLABE (Clave Bancaria Estandarizada, the 18-digit interbank account number used for SPEI transfers). Checks the control-digit checksum and decodes the bank code, plaza (branch city) code, and account number. Resolves the bank name for major Mexican banks (BBVA, Banorte, Santander, Banamex, Banco Azteca, STP, Nu, Mercado Pago, ...). Pure computation — accepts spaces or dashes in the input.

clabe.description: The 18-digit CLABE, e.g. "002010077777777771". Spaces and dashes are allowed.

name: validate_clabe
title: Validate Clabe
